audit_item: A10 / reject circular compute worker JSON payloads
finding: The compact worker transport recursively validated nested dictionaries and lists before JSON encoding, so a cyclic Python payload raised RecursionError instead of a protocol error.
change: Payload validation now uses an iterative depth-first walk, rejects active-container cycles explicitly, and normalizes JSON encoder recursion errors to ComputeProtocolError.

verification.selector: tests/test_compute_runtime_contracts.py tests/test_strict_json_constants.py tests/test_research_access.py: 164 passed with RouteB package source directories first on PYTHONPATH

boundary: Only synthetic in-memory payloads were used; no worker allocation, registry, market data, or account data was accessed.
